column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:log module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable module of structured logging. Import binds the `Log`
# namespace: `import "aql:log"  Log.info "message"`. Six severity levels
# (trace/debug/info/warn/error/fatal) fan a record out to attached sinks;
# a console sink (Go's standard `log` package → ErrOutput) is attached by
# default, with `memory` (capture-for-inspection) and `null` sinks also
# available. A global level threshold drops records below it.
# Statements are sequenced with `;` (the canonical separator) so each
# side-effecting call commits before the next reads the shared state.
# These rows route emissions to the `memory` sink and remove `console`
# so nothing is written to the test process's stderr. Captured-record
# field assertions live in the Go test (modules/log_test.go), which can
# freeze the clock and inspect typed values directly. Phase 1 surface
# only — provider hooks and spans arrive in later phases. See
# design/LOG-MODULE.10.md.
import "aql:log"  Log.get-level
column3: default global level is info

column1: import "aql:log"  Log.get-format
column3: default console format is text

column1: import "aql:log"  Log.sinks
column3: the console sink is attached by default

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.set-level warn/q ; Log.get-level
column3: set-level updates the threshold

column1: import "aql:log"  Log.enabled info/q
column3: info is enabled at the default info threshold

column1: import "aql:log"  Log.enabled debug/q
column3: debug is below the default info threshold

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.set-level error/q ; Log.enabled warn/q
column3: warn is below an error threshold

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.set-level trace/q ; Log.enabled trace/q
column3: trace is enabled at a trace threshold

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.set-format json/q ; Log.get-format
column3: set-format switches the console renderer

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.sinks
column3: add-sink attaches a registered sink

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.sinks
column3: remove-sink detaches a sink

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.sinks
column3: attaching a sink twice is idempotent

import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.info "a"
column3: a level word leaves no value on the stack

column3: each emission appends a record

column3: a record with structured fields is captured

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.set-level warn/q ; Log.info "a" ; Log.dump size
column3: a record below the threshold is dropped before fan-out

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.log error/q "boom" ; Log.dump size
column3: Log.log emits at a computed level

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.info "a" ; Log.clear ; Log.dump size
column3: clear empties the capture buffer

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.set-level trace/q ; Log.trace "t" ; Log.debug "d" ; Log.dump size
column3: trace and debug emit once the threshold is lowered

column1: import "aql:log" ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; Log.error "e" ; Log.fatal "f" ; Log.dump size
column3: error and fatal emit at the default threshold

column1: import "aql:log" ; def l (Log.logger "http") ; typeof l
column3: a logger instance is a Map of method closures

column1: import "aql:log" ; def l (Log.with "http" {svc:"api"}) ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; l.info "req" ; Log.dump 0 get "logger" get
column3: a logger stamps its name onto each record

column1: import "aql:log" ; def l (Log.with "http" {svc:"api"}) ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; l.info "req" {path:"/x"} ; Log.dump 0 get "attributes" get
column3: a logger merges its defaults under the call's fields

column1: import "aql:log" ; def l (Log.with "a" {x:1}) ; def c (l.child {y:2}) ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; c.info "m" ; Log.dump 0 get "attributes" get
column3: a child logger layers more defaults over its parent's

column1: import "aql:log" ; def l (Log.with "a" {x:1}) ; Log.add-sink memory/q ; Log.remove-sink console/q ; l.error "boom" {x:2} ; Log.dump 0 get "attributes" get
column3: a call field overrides a same-named logger default
